svg.title: Mumbai, 27 December 2025: historical municipal boundary and MUMBAI label
svg.desc: Full northern-to-southern Mumbai crop. Only MUMBAI is labeled. Historical DataMeet outline is not current official limits. Surrounding land is context.
svg.metadata: Imagery: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025; https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu/licences/ec-sentinel . Boundary: Pune chapter of the DataMeet Trust, Bangalore, India; dissolved/projected derivative CC BY-SA 2.5 India; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/in/ . Locality anchors: GeoNames CC BY. These layers retain separate licences. See README.md and data/mumbai-imagery/review.json for provenance.
